events.preview_text: Line up posts ahead and still slot in a local update
events.body:
Planning posts ahead and reacting to today's news feel like opposites. Plan too far out and a timely update means tearing up the schedule.

Buffer is an app for scheduling your Facebook and Instagram posts into a queue you can plan ahead and rearrange whenever something comes up.

So when something happens at the shop today, you're not stuck. You move that post into the queue — rearrange or shuffle the order — instead of rebuilding the week you already planned.

Foster Coffee Company plans a couple of weeks ahead this way: far enough out to stay ahead of the schedule, flexible enough to add something at the last minute.

Before you try a weekly queue, it's worth knowing what it costs. The Free plan holds **10 scheduled posts per channel** at a time; paid plans lift that cap. Take a look and see whether a week of posts fits.

events.preview_text: So today's update has an obvious place to go
events.body:
You keep next week's posts in your head — a few lined up, room left for whatever happens at the shop. Without the week in front of you, it's hard to tell if adding today's update crowds out something you already planned.

Buffer is an app for scheduling your Facebook and Instagram posts into a queue. Its visual content calendar lays that queue out across the week and month, so fitting in today's post becomes a decision you can see.

Planning ahead doesn't lock you in. When something comes up, you can rearrange the queue — drag posts around or shuffle the order — and a timely update slots in without rebuilding your schedule.

On the Free plan, you can line up **10 scheduled posts per channel** at a time. Whether that's enough for a week depends on how often you post — worth a look before you try a weekly queue.

Buffer is social media management software for scheduling those posts. Rather than pin each one to a fixed time, you drop them into a queue you can rearrange or shuffle whenever you want.

Worth checking before you build one: whether a week of your posts fits inside that free limit.

events.body:
You can line up several posts ahead and still keep room for whatever happens at the shop today.

Buffer is social media management software for scheduling your Facebook and Instagram posts. Instead of pinning each one to a fixed time, you drop them into a queue you can rearrange or shuffle.

So when something local comes up, you add that post and slot it where you want. The rest of the week stays put — no starting over.

Foster Coffee plans a couple of weeks out and still, in their words, can "stay ahead of the schedule without scrambling to find content."

The queue comes on every Buffer plan, free included. The Free plan holds **10 scheduled posts per channel** at a time — and each time a post publishes, its slot opens again, so a few posts a week keep rolling inside that limit.

Before you build a weekly queue, see the Free plan's limits next to what the paid plans add, so you know up front what your week costs.
